city.name: Philadelphia

events.title: Boyz II Men with The Philly Pops

events.title: Bikini Kill
events.description: The pioneering riot grrrl band that helped define '90s punk feminism plays one of Philly's best-loved midsize rock rooms.

events.title: Ben Harper and The Innocent Criminals

events.title: Ed Sheeran: Loop Tour

events.title: Jason Aldean: Songs About Us Tour
events.description: Country hitmaker Jason Aldean plays the outdoor amphitheater on the Camden Waterfront as part of his Songs About Us tour.

events.title: Rick Glassman

events.title: 2026 Philly's Phunniest - Final Round
events.description: Nine local comedians face off in the championship round of Philly's Phunniest, competing for the title and a $3,500 prize.

events.title: A Nation of Artists: Exhibition Tour

events.description: A guided walkthrough of PAFA's half of the two-museum "A Nation of Artists" exhibition, exploring three centuries of American art with a knowledgeable docent.
events.sourceName: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts

events.title: CollegeFest 2026 at PAFA
events.venue: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
events.description: College students get free entry to PAFA plus a citywide block party and free PHLASH rides as part of Campus Philly's CollegeFest weekend.
events.sourceName: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts

events.title: Wild Sight: Thomas Chimes on the Edge of the Rational

events.title: Play Without Boundaries

events.description: A sensory-friendly early morning session at Please Touch Museum, designed for kids with autism, sensory sensitivities or other disabilities and their families.

events.title: Democracy For All Week: Freedom of Expression
events.description: Interactive tours and art-making activities at the historic penitentiary examine how journalism, music and poetry moved within prisons and jails.

events.title: CollegeFest 2026 at Eastern State
events.priceLabel: Free for registered students ($1 service fee)
events.description: Registered college students get discounted daytime admission to explore the crumbling cellblocks of this 19th-century penitentiary.

events.title: Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show

events.title: Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show
events.description: The art show's biggest day draws crowds to browse painting, photography, sculpture and jewelry from over 140 exhibiting artists around the square.

events.title: Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show
events.description: On its closing day, the fine art show wraps up a weekend that typically draws more than 20,000 visitors to Rittenhouse Square.

events.title: We Are the Seeds Philly: Indigenous Arts & Culture Festival + Pow Wow

events.title: We Are the Seeds Philly: Indigenous Arts & Culture Festival + Pow Wow
events.address: 121 North Christopher Columbus Boulevard, Philadelphia, PA 19106
events.description: The festival's closing day continues its celebration of Indigenous culture with live performances, dance and a full artisan marketplace.

events.title: Scarecrow Festival at Peddler's Village
events.description: Bucks County's shopping village kicks off its scarecrow season with a festival weekend of family activities, live music and fall crafts.

events.title: Scarecrow Festival at Peddler's Village
events.description: The festival wraps up before the village's famous scarecrow display, over 150 handmade figures, lines the brick pathways through late October.

events.title: Philadelphia Fall Arts Fest
events.description: A free day of performances celebrating the Kimmel Center's 25th anniversary, featuring the Philadelphia Orchestra, Opera Philadelphia, Philadelphia Ballet and Philly POPS.

events.title: Upper Darby International Festival

events.title: 48 Blocks Festival

events.title: The Count's Halloween Spooktacular

events.title: Headhouse Farmers Market

events.title: Rittenhouse Farmers Market
events.description: Farm to City's Saturday market brings fresh produce, meats, dairy and artisanal goods to the edge of Rittenhouse Square year-round.

events.title: Sankofa Farm Stand at Clark Park
events.description: Bartram's Garden's urban farm sells fresh, chemical-free produce grown at its Sankofa Community Farm alongside the regular Clark Park market.

events.title: Free Boating at Bartram's Garden

events.title: Horticulture Volunteer Day
events.description: Pitch in on seasonal plantings and invasive-species removal alongside Bartram's Garden's horticulture staff on the historic grounds.

events.title: Walking the Schuylkill: John Brady Photography
events.description: Photographer John Brady's images tracing the length of the Schuylkill River are on view for a full day at the historic Water Works center.

events.title: Garden Club Federation of Pennsylvania Flower Show

events.title: Garden Club Federation of Pennsylvania Flower Show
events.description: On its second day, the statewide flower show continues to fill Longwood's conservatory with competitive floral arrangements.

events.title: Field & Flame - A Culinary Experience at Granogue
events.address: Granogue, Longwood Gardens, Kennett Square, PA 19348
events.description: An open-fire culinary event at Longwood's Granogue property pairs live cooking demonstrations with a farm-to-table evening outdoors.

events.title: Field & Flame - A Culinary Experience at Granogue
events.address: Granogue, Longwood Gardens, Kennett Square, PA 19348
events.description: The second seating of Longwood's open-fire dining experience at Granogue closes out the weekend with live-fire cooking outdoors.

events.title: Drive-In Zoovies: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

events.title: Outdoor Yoga at Glen Foerd

events.title: FDR Park Community Workday 2
events.description: Volunteers are welcome to pitch in on habitat restoration work at Pattison Lagoon as part of FDR Park's ongoing revitalization.

events.title: Community Paddle Boating at FDR Park
events.description: See FDR Park's lake from a new angle with free community paddle boating at the historic boathouse.

events.title: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival — road trip
